review_notes.note: 頸部疼痛伴隨呼吸困難、胸痛、嚴重頭痛、或局部神經功能缺損（如手臂無力、麻木）可能是警訊症狀，需優先評估。RAG 文獻提及這些症狀與心肌梗塞或嚴重神經問題有關。
頸部僵硬伴隨發燒或畏寒，可能指向感染性疾病（如腦膜炎），應優先處理。RAG 文獻提及萊姆病等感染可能出現此類症狀。
若頸部疼痛源於嚴重創傷（如車禍、墜落），可能涉及脊椎或血管損傷，有立即生命危險。應優先啟動創傷緊急流程，而非僅填寫問卷。

Self-diagnosis and self-treatment or diagnosis by practitioners without adequate laboratory testing may also contribute to misdiagnosis. Now in its third edition, this system includes a tension-type headache (TTH) category, further defined as either episodic (frequent and infrequent) or chronic. In infrequent episodic TTH, headache episodes occur less than one day a month, whereas in frequent episodic TTH, headache episodes occur 1 to 14 days a month. Neck injury may result in the laceration of major vessels, potentially leading to hemorrhagic shock. Extracranial arterial injuries to the brachiocephalic, common carotid, and vertebral arteries can result in major neurologic deficits. Airway occlusion and exsanguinating hemorrhage pose the most immediate risks to life.
